name: iphone-tracker-realtime
goal: The open iPhone Tracker inbox re-renders within about 1 s of a tracker change: the phone follows the account live socket, pulls its replica on each notice and reconnect, pushes a native event to the page, and shows Live/Reconnecting honestly

evidence: Scope in specification/features/planned/phone-tracker-replica.md 'Live pushes'. Built on main without PR #340: the inbox is fed by the relay replica; no sealed scope is subscribed.
TrackerDoorbell + URLSession channel, coalesced pull per notice/reconnect, native 'tracker' event, phone TrackerInboxSource.watch, followTrackerSource re-reads on changed while reconnecting.
38 new native checks (dropped-notice mutation fails 2 in Debug and Release), 4 vitest cases, ui-tracker-phone-live browser spec with inspected Live and Reconnecting screenshots.

iOS native Debug 383/Release 367, sealed, limits 0, simulator build+launch; desktop format/types/lint/audit, unit suite with its one failure fixed and rerun, headless e2e 289 pass 7 skip; root format/types/lint/audit/units/guard checks, 54 unit-graph tests; ios:measure:live publish-to-event p95 16-31 ms over 30. Full root bun run check and Electron specs not run.
